meta.notes: Все ID — латиница в нижнем регистре, дефисы. Связи только через ID. Блок mvp_estimates содержит оценочные параметры для MVP (не паспортные).

mass_kg.note: Weight includes battery and propellers; camera mass not additionally modeled.

airspeed_m_s.note: MVP cruise: 0.8 * maximum horizontal speed (15 m/s).

survey_speed_m_s.note: Existing MVP uses survey speed = working airspeed, not maximum speed.

max_horizontal_speed_m_s.note: Maximum horizontal capability, not working survey speed.

climb_m_s.note: Vertical maximum used as MVP climb scalar; no detailed launch profile.

descent_m_s.note: Repository section 6.2 explicitly assumes symmetric vertical ascent/descent; descent is an assumption, not independently confirmed passport.

minimum_airspeed_m_s.source: CAT-001B makes existing factory moving-flight floor explicit
minimum_airspeed_m_s.note: Required by terrain splitting: numerical moving-flight lower bound, NOT rotor stall speed. No manufacturer bound; plausible MVP 0.5-2 m/s, choose existing 1 m/s to avoid changing terrain algorithm.

flight_time_s.note: 40 min * 60; advertised maximum under favorable conditions.

battery_energy_wh.note: Manufacturer battery energy; deterministic aircraft configuration, not fallback.

reserve_fraction.note: Existing MVP 5% reserve policy, not hardware specification.

turn_time_s.note: Choose conservative 5 s from existing MVP alternatives [5,3,1]; fixed turn penalty.

max_wind_m_s.note: Hard wind capability ceiling; directional ground-speed physics remains separate.

takeoff_overhead_s.note: Vertical launch has no additional fixed overhead in existing MVP; h/climb accounts for launch.

landing_overhead_s.note: Vertical landing has no additional fixed overhead in existing MVP; h/descent accounts for landing.

kh.note: Repository base/hover coefficient, not manufacturer measured power.

kv.note: Repository cubic airspeed coefficient; formula unchanged.

mass_kg.note: MTOW includes payload; never add the 1.5 kg payload limit.

airspeed_m_s.note: Chosen working speed within 64-130 km/h; not the exact midpoint.

survey_speed_m_s.note: Existing MVP uses survey speed = working airspeed, not maximum speed.

max_horizontal_speed_m_s.note: Upper capability: 130 km/h / 3.6. Not solver cruise.

descent_m_s.note: Required for descent/landing timing; no confirmed scalar in repository/manufacturer excerpts. Plausible MVP range 1-5 m/s, choose conservative 2 m/s independently of 3 m/s climb. Not a measured parachute sink rate.

minimum_airspeed_m_s.note: Repository stall estimate used as minimum controllable airspeed.

stall_speed_m_s.note: Repository stall estimate; not the manufacturer's flight-speed lower limit.

flight_time_s.note: 180 min * 60; advertised maximum, not battery-guaranteed endurance.

battery_energy_wh.note: 40 Ah * 18.5 V = 740 Wh (repository configuration, confirmed Russian manual p116). Older English manual p98 specifies a different 34 Ah battery; that variant is not selected.

reserve_fraction.note: Existing MVP 5% reserve policy, not hardware specification.

turn_time_s.note: 180-degree turn approximation: pi * repository rounded radius 110 m / 25 m/s = 13.823 s. Radius/bank are MVP assumptions, not measured turn performance.

max_wind_m_s.note: Hard wind capability ceiling; directional ground-speed physics remains separate.

takeoff_overhead_s.note: Existing catapult allowance; ascent h/climb is added separately.

landing_overhead_s.note: Existing parachute allowance plus independent h/descent approximation; no detailed deployment dynamics.

recharge_time_s.source: CAT-001B explicit legacy spare-battery timing assumption
recharge_time_s.note: Required by repeated-sortie timing; no confirmed cycle time. MVP assumes immediate replacement by precharged spare (0 s downtime, not instant battery charging). Nonnegative handling range 0-600 s; choose zero to preserve existing schedule. Spare logistics are not modeled.

constant_power_w.note: Existing constant-flight-power approximation; 220 W motor rating is NOT a measured average. 740 Wh / 3 h = 246.67 W, so equality is not claimed.

environment.operating_temperature: base battery: -20 to +40 °C; Arctic battery: -40 to +20 °C
